title: Sahib e Qirdar Hai Ghazi
body:
Tausan sawaar sahibe kirdaar hai gazi
Karbobala ka haidare qaraar hai gazi
Haider ki ilteja hai dua fatema ki hai ×2
Dine khuda ka Qafla salaar hai gazi
Chinne lagi  rida to sada alqama ne di ×2
Zainab teri rida ka azadaar hai gazi
Ta hashr tera shukriya aye madare jari ×2
Aisa jawaan kiya ke alamdaar hai gazi
Dariya ko jisne cheen ke pani nahi piya ×2
Zaate wafa mei aisa wafadaar hai gazi
Jalti hue zameen ke hoto pe thi buqa ×2
Boli labe furat ke ghumkhwaar hai gazi
Jiski ada pe kaap gae arze nai nawa ×2
Haider tere jalaal ki talwaar hai gazi
Yawar ke har khayaal ko de martaba juda ×2
Naukar tera Tera qalam kar hai gazi
